operatorTests.scope: local unit/integration fixtures; no blockchain submissions

history.resolution: Set Playwright path through GITHUB_ENV after runner starts; runner context is unavailable in job-level env

history.result: Devnet 31/31 in every engine; Chromium main 12/12; Firefox/WebKit main image decode ran before lazy loading finished
history.resolution: Wait for load completion before decode; retain image assertions

history.result: Chromium and Firefox passed; WebKit runner found an RPC timeout classification race in unit tests before browser setup
history.resolution: Classify an attempt capped by the remaining overall deadline as TIMEOUT; add clock-advance regression test

limitations: RPC and wallets in browser scenarios are simulated.
Device descriptors exercise viewport, user agent and touch options, not physical Android/iOS or wallet apps.
WebKit on Linux is not the released Safari browser on an iPhone.
No wallet owner signature or blockchain submission performed.
Dedicated RPC remains unconfigured; public Devnet rate limits and uptime are not guaranteed.
Public sales remain closed; Mainnet purchase is not enabled or verified.
